question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Climate change and environmental __**degradation**__ are an existential threat to Europe and the world.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Development)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Degradation"** means the process of something becoming worse or being reduced in quality, value, or strength. (अवमूल्यन, गिरावट)

 
 
• **Example:** The degradation of the forest due to excessive logging is a major concern.
 
 
 
• **"Development"** refers to the process of growth, improvement, or a positive change in quality or condition. (विकास)
 
 
• **Example:** The city has seen remarkable development over the past decade with modern infrastructure and facilities.
 
 
 
• Since "Development" is a positive process and the opposite of "Degradation," it is the most appropriate antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Development)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demand **(मांग): The desire or need for something to be bought or used.

 
 
• **Example:** The demand for electric vehicles is increasing due to environmental concerns.
 
 
 
• **Disaster **(आपदा): A sudden, catastrophic event causing great damage or suffering.
 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake was a disaster that left thousands homeless.
 
 
 
• **Distribution **(वितरण): The act of sharing or spreading something over a range of areas.
 
 
• **Example:** The distribution of resources was uneven, leading to disputes.
 
 

**Question:** Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**
Climate change and environmental degradation are an existential threat to Europe and the world.

Correct Answer:** Option 3 (Development)
